common_affordance: The graph is necessarily a connected tree, so the answer is the sum of the edges in the unique minimal subtree containing all priority buildings.

defeated_student_causes.why_failed: Its DSU/Kruskal-style approach does not correctly account for non-priority relay buildings and the required Steiner subtree; it treats the task more like spanning priority vertices directly.

recommended_edit: No legal edit can defeat all survivors while preserving the immutable numeric condition and connectivity guarantee. Any effective edit would have to permit extra links or otherwise stop the input graph from being forced to a tree.
regression_risk: Changing the graph structure could make the defeated DSU/Kruskal-style solution correct again.
